title: Counter-Strike: Source
provenance: Reported by ak9m12 (highball#482, 2026-10-25), Apple M4, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.22, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, DXVK, msync: the game ran, the mouse lagged. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: The 64-bit build (cstrike_win64.exe) starts and plays on the default engine through DXVK on an M4, but the mouse input lags (highball#482). The same session hit Wine 10's limit of 256 realized fonts ('out of realized font handles'); the Wine 11 engine allows 5000. Nothing was measured here.

knownIssues.symptom: Mouse input lags (reported on an M4, macOS 27.0.1, DXVK, engine r28, highball#482)
knownIssues.fix: none confirmed yet. Turning off Wait for vertical sync in the game's video settings and trying m_rawinput 1 in the console are the first things to try
